title: [3.0-beta7] Warning message to change pump driver after renewing Eros pod
symptom: After changing an Eros pod, a red warning bar appeared later stating 'Data is from another pump. Change pump driver to reset the pump status'. The time mentioned in the message is the time of the pod change, though the message appeared much later. It looks the pump data is not really cleared or updated after de-activating the pod.
evidence_quote: Some time after the change a red warning bar appeared which stated: "Data is from another pump. Change pump driver to reset the pump status".
